# ThePaperLeaf

> ThePaperLeaf is an independent magazine-style news publication focused on clear, visual, and context-rich reporting for curious readers.

## Primary reader routes

- [Home](https://www.thepaperleaf.com/): Latest stories, featured editorial picks, topic navigation, and subscription callout.
- [About](https://www.thepaperleaf.com/page/about-thepaperleaf): Publication purpose, editorial approach, and reader promise.
- [Search](https://www.thepaperleaf.com/search): Reader-facing story search.
- [Sitemap](https://www.thepaperleaf.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of public pages, categories, and articles.
- [RSS feed](https://www.thepaperleaf.com/rss.xml): Latest published stories in RSS format.

## Topic routes

- [Business](https://www.thepaperleaf.com/category/business): Markets, work, companies, and economic signals.
- [Technology](https://www.thepaperleaf.com/category/technology): Platforms, devices, AI, research tools, and digital culture.
- [Culture](https://www.thepaperleaf.com/category/culture): Media, arts, design, entertainment, and publishing shifts.
- [World](https://www.thepaperleaf.com/category/world): International developments and global context.
- [Science](https://www.thepaperleaf.com/category/science): Climate, health, discovery, space, and research explainers.
- [Sport](https://www.thepaperleaf.com/category/sport): Competition, analysis, athletes, events, and sport systems.

## Public data

- [Latest published stories](https://www.thepaperleaf.com/api/v1/posts): Public JSON feed of published articles.
- [Public categories](https://www.thepaperleaf.com/api/v1/categories): Public JSON list of active topic categories.

## Use guidance

Use story title, canonical article URL, publication date, author, and source label when citing ThePaperLeaf. Public article pages and feeds are intended for reader discovery. Search and category pages are navigational.
